items.title: Developmental-ecology Fishtank successor: layout continuity + probabilistic microhabitat-zone habitat cue + sleep-vs-no-sleep ablation (2 arms x 2 seeds x 24 segments)
items.note: Routed from chip-20260810-fishtank-developmental-ecology (spawned 2026-08-10T06:44Z by relaxed-shtern-75392b, twice-amended same day by session angry-heisenberg-e8fec7). Combines THREE findings into ONE successor per reef_ecology_strategy_affective_occupancy_review_2026-08-10.md Section 8's explicit 'additive, not a duplicate' framing: (1) LAYOUT CONTINUITY -- env.reset() re-rolls hazard/resource layout at every segment boundary, confounding within-life development analysis (organism_lifespan_development_review_906_lineage_2026-08-10.md Section 1/7/10 item 2); fixed via env.reset_to() (SD-029/EXQ-433a comparator-harness API) instead of env.reset() at every boundary after the first, persisting the SAME hazard/resource layout for the whole 24-segment life. (2) PROBABILISTIC HABITAT CUE -- developmental_ecology_curiosity_foraging_correction_2026-08-10.md Section 4, CORRECTING an earlier overreach (making food directly sensible from the reef) with a discoverability-through-exploration + probabilistic-region-cue requirement. SUBSTRATE READINESS FINDING (Step 2.5a): the correction document's own 'landmark' suggestion (SD-023 n_landmarks_b) was probed and found mechanically workable but UNSAFE for a first-pass build -- n_landmarks_a/b grows world_obs_dim by 50 (causal_grid_world.py:1385), and since the SAME agent is trained through the whole curriculum before eval, turning it on only at eval would size the encoder for 250-wide observations during training and feed it 300-wide ones at eval (a shape-mismatch crash) unless every curriculum phase's env construction is also touched -- invasive for a 'first pass, avoid unnecessary complexity' build. Used microhabitat zones instead (infant_substrate:GAP-2, microhabitat_enabled) -- confirmed by direct source read to NOT affect world_obs_dim/body_obs_dim at all, so it is safe as an eval-env-only post-hoc override with zero training/eval shape-mismatch risk. It already implements exactly the correction document's Section 4b design principle (a MULTIPLICATIVE, non-deterministic resource/hazard placement-weighting by zone, not a guaranteed-food zone type); the zone identity is sensed only INDIRECTLY, through the resulting regional differences in the already-sensed resource_field/hazard_field -- an explicit, honest trade-off recorded in the module docstring, not the literal dedicated-marker framing the correction document originally suggested. num_resources raised 5->24 (DEV_NUM_RESOURCES) since layout continuity means the initial draw is the WHOLE life's food supply, not a fresh per-segment draw; resource_respawn_on_consume left False to avoid diluting the zone-weighted signal with uniformly-placed respawns. (3) SLEEP-VS-NO-SLEEP ABLATION -- sleep_transition_investigation_906_lineage_2026-08-10.md Section 9, extending reef_ecology_strategy_affective_occupancy_review_2026-08-10.md Section 6/8 item 2: 906b/906c's one real sleep firing coincides with a segment-boundary reset, so no existing data can separate 'sleep changed behaviour' from 'elapsed time changed behaviour regardless of sleep'. Two-arm design (ARM_WITH_SLEEP: use_sleep_loop=True, K=10 cadence, unchanged from 906b; ARM_NO_SLEEP: use_sleep_loop=False, SleepLoopManager never constructed, confirmed via ree_core/agent.py:2630) with matched pre-boundary experience (both arms share the same seed -> same env._rng draws -> same persisted layout under finding 1) gives the missing no-sleep control. For every WITH_SLEEP boundary that actually fires, compares turning-angle entropy / straight-run length / tortuosity / hazard-conditioned turning (local 100-step post-boundary window) against the SAME segment index in the NO_SLEEP arm. MECH-357 CHECK (organism review Section 10 item 7): confirmed use_instrumental_avoidance=True already active in _make_config() -- no additional probe added this pass. SCOPE, NOT ADDED (stated explicitly in module docstring): SD-025/MECH-314 per-tick novelty-term telemetry (correction doc Section 6) was not added -- would meaningfully grow this already-large script's scope; multi-context ecology (correction doc Section 7) and the fuller sleep-richness factorial (investigation doc Section 5) were both deliberately not built, per each document's own 'avoid unnecessary complexity in a first pass' instruction. GOV-REUSE-1: no existing manifest holds a layout-continuous multi-segment run, a sleep-vs-no-sleep ablation, or a zone-weighted ecology; not recoverable by reanalysis. Re-derive brake (2.5b): claim_ids=[], not applicable. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entry touches causal_grid_world.py or this driver's other imports. claim_ids=[] (diagnostic showcase, does not weight governance), EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic. Smoke PASS: --dry-run (3 segments x 30 steps, 2 seeds x 2 arms) exercised the full curriculum + layout-continuous eval + trajectory-organization + zone-habitat + within-life-development + sleep-ablation-comparison code paths cleanly; z_goal_stream smoke check reports 'no writer defect' (active_frac=0.998); all 4 verdict/progress-instrumentation lines present and correctly denominated. One bug found and fixed during smoke testing: an initial layout_continuity_confirmed check compared post-boundary hazard positions against the ep0 canonical draw and failed on every segment, because hazard drift (env_drift_interval/env_drift_prob, constructor default 5/0.3, unchanged pre-existing ecology dynamic) moves hazards WITHIN a segment regardless of this run's changes -- the check conflated that orthogonal, already-existing dynamic with the layout-RE-RANDOMIZATION confound this run actually fixes. Corrected to a purely structural check (every boundary after ep0 used env.reset_to(), not env.reset()); the original hazard-drift comparison is kept as a descriptive (non-gating) per-segment field.
